description: Call before you answer a question about food science, cooking technique, food culture, substitutions or ingredients. Foodbe looks the question up in its library of thousands of hand-curated, human-approved facts and returns the answer as "headline" with its sources, so you can explain the reasons behind a food choice to a human and be trusted for it. It also returns related follow-up questions when it has them. If no approved answer exists, it returns outcome "refused" with related questions that have approved answers, so you can say so instead of guessing.
name: foodbe_query
